name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme covering all stages of crop cycle including post-harvest losses.
benefits: Up to ₹2 lakh insurance coverage per farmer
Premium as low as 1.5% for Rabi crops, 2% for Kharif crops
Covers drought, flood, cyclone, hailstorm, landslide, pest/disease
eligibility: All farmers (loanee and non-loanee) growing notified crops in notified areas
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest bank branch, CSC center, or online at pmfby.gov.in
deadline: Before crop season (Kharif: July 31, Rabi: December 31)

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
description: Promotes organic farming through cluster approach. Financial assistance for 3-year organic conversion.
benefits: ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic farming
eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming; minimum cluster of 50 acres
how_to_apply: Contact district agriculture office or state organic mission

name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to all eligible farmer families.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal instalments of ₹2,000
Direct bank transfer to farmer account
eligibility: All small and marginal farmer families with cultivable land
how_to_apply: Apply at pmkisan.gov.in or nearest CSC/bank

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
description: Scheme for holistic development of agriculture including infrastructure, technology, and market linkages.
benefits: Subsidy for farm machinery and equipment (up to 50%)
Support for cold storage, processing units
eligibility: Individual farmers, FPOs, cooperatives, state governments
deadline: Annual budget cycle — apply before March

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
description: Enhancing production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals and commercial crops through area expansion and productivity enhancement.
benefits: Subsidy on micronutrients and soil amendments
eligibility: Farmers in NFSM districts growing target crops

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
description: Support for development of horticulture including fruits, vegetables, spices, and flowers.
eligibility: Horticulture farmers; priority to small/marginal farmers

name: National Mission on Oilseeds and Oil Palm (NMOOP)
description: Scheme to increase production of oilseeds and expand oil palm cultivation.
benefits: Seed mini-kit distribution free of cost
eligibility: Farmers in NMOOP districts growing oilseeds or oil palm

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Agriculture
description: Short-term credit for agricultural needs at concessional interest rates.
benefits: Credit limit based on land holding and crop pattern
Interest rate as low as 4% per annum (with subvention)
Covers crop cultivation, maintenance, and harvest expenses
eligibility: All farmers — owner cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, SHGs
how_to_apply: Apply at any commercial bank, RRB, or cooperative bank

name: MGNREGA Agricultural Works
description: Employment guarantee for agricultural works like land development, water harvesting, and farm ponds.
benefits: 100 days guaranteed employment at minimum wages
eligibility: Rural household members willing to do unskilled manual work

name: Maharashtra Drip Irrigation Subsidy (MH)
description: Maharashtra state scheme for drip and sprinkler irrigation with high subsidy.
benefits: Up to 80% subsidy on drip irrigation for small farmers
Covers pipes, emitters, filters, and control heads
eligibility: Maharashtra farmers with agricultural land and water source
how_to_apply: Apply at district agriculture office or online at mahapocra.gov.in

name: Agricultural Technology Management Agency (ATMA)
description: District-level agency for agricultural extension, training, and technology transfer to farmers.
benefits: Free training on modern farming techniques
how_to_apply: Contact block technology team at block agriculture office
